en-US.title: Decree: Scroll To-Do Lists
en-US.subtitle: Lists kept by a loyal scribe
en-US.description:
Decree turns your to-do lists into scrolls, kept in order by a scribe who calls you M'lord, M'lady or my liege.

There are almost no buttons. You pull down to write a new line, swipe right to strike one done, and push up from the foot of a scroll to roll it shut. Each item you finish plays the next note of a short tune, so finishing a scroll plays the whole thing.

WRITE AS FAST AS YOU THINK
• Pull down to add a line, and keep typing to add several
• Paste a block of text to add one line for each row
• End a line with a colon to start a section
• End a line with "@ 5pm" or "@ tomorrow 9am" to be reminded

GESTURES FOR EVERYTHING
• Swipe right to strike an item done, left to cast it out
• Hold and drag to reorder, with whole sections moving together
• Pinch apart to write between two lines, pinch together to roll the scroll up
• Restore anything you removed by mistake

A SCRIBE AT YOUR DESK
• Greets you by the hour and remarks on what you do
• Notices a scroll that has gathered dust
• Chatty, quiet or silent, as you prefer

MADE TO BE KEPT
• Daily scrolls that renew themselves each dawn
• Seal a finished scroll into the Chronicle, a dated record of everything you have struck done
• Five papers, from Scriptorium to Night Vigil, each with a matching app icon
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Search across every scroll

YOURS ALONE
Your scrolls stay on your device. There is no account, no tracking and no advertising. Back up to a file whenever you wish.
en-US.promoText: Every list is a scroll, and a scribe keeps them in order. Pull to write, swipe to strike, and hear each finished scroll play its tune.
